item.omnitech.gate_template_and.desc: Output is 1 only when both A and B are 1.
item.omnitech.gate_template_or.desc: Output is 1 when at least one of A or B is 1.
item.omnitech.gate_template_nand.desc: Output is 0 only when both A and B are 1.
item.omnitech.gate_template_nor.desc: Output is 1 only when both A and B are 0.
item.omnitech.gate_template_xor.desc: Output is 1 when A and B differ.
item.omnitech.gate_template_xnor.desc: Output is 1 when A and B are equal.
item.omnitech.gate_template_buffer_a.des: Output mirrors input A, ignores B.
item.omnitech.gate_template_not_a.desc: Output is the inverse of input A, ignores B.
item.omnitech.gate_template_buffer_b.des: Output mirrors input B, ignores A.
item.omnitech.gate_template_not_b.desc: Output is the inverse of input B, ignores A.
item.omnitech.gate_template_always_on.de: Output is always 1, regardless of inputs.
item.omnitech.gate_template_always_off.d: Output is always 0, regardless of inputs.
item.omnitech.gate_template_imply.desc: Output is 0 only when A is 1 and B is 0 (A implies B).
item.omnitech.gate_template_nimply.desc: Output is 1 only when A is 1 and B is 0.
gui.omnitech.truth_table.hint1: A & B are inputs, OUT is output.
gui.omnitech.truth_table.hint2: All 4 input pairs must appear once.
gui.omnitech.truth_table.legend2: AND OR NAND NOR XOR XNOR and more.

tooltip.omnitech.boiler.desc: Burns fuel to heat water into steam pressure for engines.
tooltip.omnitech.stirling_engine.desc: Converts a heat difference into kinetic force (KF).
tooltip.omnitech.kf_generator.desc: Converts steam pressure into kinetic force (KF).
tooltip.omnitech.heater.desc: Pushes heat into any adjacent block that accepts it.
tooltip.omnitech.alloy_furnace.desc: Melts and combines metals into alloys.
tooltip.omnitech.manual_macerator.desc: Crushes ores and items into dusts.
tooltip.omnitech.manual_centrifuge.desc: Spins dusts apart into their component materials.
tooltip.omnitech.smelter.desc: Melts ores and dusts into molten metal.
tooltip.omnitech.foundry.desc: Casts molten metal into ingots and shapes.
tooltip.omnitech.glass_blowing_station.d: Shapes heated sand into glass blocks, panes, bottles and flasks.
tooltip.omnitech.crank.desc: Manually generates a short burst of kinetic force (KF).
tooltip.omnitech.kf_reductor.desc: Steps kinetic force (KF) up or down between networks.
tooltip.omnitech.sorter.desc: Routes items to different outputs by filter.
tooltip.omnitech.fluid_pipe.desc: Carries fluid between machines and tanks.
tooltip.omnitech.pump.desc: Actively pushes fluid through the pipe network.
tooltip.omnitech.fluid_tank.desc: Stores a large volume of a single fluid.
tooltip.omnitech.valve.desc: Opens or closes to control fluid flow through pipes.
tooltip.omnitech.fluid_collector.desc: Passively collects a fluid from the world, such as rain or ocean water.
tooltip.omnitech.fluid_filler.desc: Fills buckets, canisters and flasks from a connected fluid source.
tooltip.omnitech.fluid_canister.desc: A refillable metal canister for common fluids.
tooltip.omnitech.electric_engine.desc: Converts kinetic force (KF) to EU, or EU to KF in reverse.
tooltip.omnitech.power_relay.desc: Extends and branches an electrical wire network.
tooltip.omnitech.electric_furnace.desc: Electric-powered furnace that smelts items without fuel.
tooltip.omnitech.electric_heater.desc: Electric-powered heat source for adjacent machines.
tooltip.omnitech.assembler.desc: Automatically crafts items from a stored recipe.
tooltip.omnitech.solvation_machine.desc: Dissolves a dust into a fluid, using kinetic force (KF).
tooltip.omnitech.filter_press.desc: Filters undissolved solids out of a fluid solution, using kinetic force (KF).
tooltip.omnitech.electrolysis_machine.de: Splits a fluid into its component fluids using electricity.
tooltip.omnitech.rotary_compressor.desc: Compresses a fluid to raise its pressure.
tooltip.omnitech.heat_exchanger.desc: Transfers heat between two separate fluid streams.
tooltip.omnitech.decompressor.desc: Lowers a fluid's pressure, releasing cold as it expands.
tooltip.omnitech.fractional_distiller.de: Separates a fluid mixture into fractions by boiling point.
tooltip.omnitech.chemical_reactor.desc: Reacts two fluids together into new products.
tooltip.omnitech.rocket_controller.desc: Controls a rocket's launch and flight to other planets and moons.
tooltip.omnitech.chemical_infuser.desc: Infuses a fluid into an item, or an item into a fluid.
tooltip.omnitech.extractor.desc: Extracts a fluid from an item, such as squeezing plant matter.
tooltip.omnitech.radiator.desc: Radiates excess heat away into the air.
tooltip.omnitech.radio_transmitter.desc: Broadcasts audio or data on a chosen frequency.
tooltip.omnitech.radio_receiver.desc: Picks up audio or data on a chosen frequency.
tooltip.omnitech.radio_scanner.desc: Scans the radio spectrum for active frequencies.
tooltip.omnitech.analog_cable.desc: Carries an analog audio signal between radio devices.
tooltip.omnitech.microphone.desc: Captures your voice to send over a radio transmitter.
tooltip.omnitech.speaker.desc: Plays received audio, or a stored tone.
tooltip.omnitech.radio_locator.desc: A handheld tool that points toward a chosen frequency's source.
tooltip.omnitech.programming_station.des: Writes assembly programs onto Firmware ROMs and Microcontrollers.
tooltip.omnitech.logic_cable.desc: Carries digital signals between logic components.
tooltip.omnitech.logic_machine.desc: A RISC-V computer that runs a program from a Firmware ROM.
tooltip.omnitech.research_table.desc: Unlocks new blueprints by solving a minesweeper puzzle.
tooltip.omnitech.reactor_block.desc: The core of a nuclear reactor; houses fuel cells and control rods.
tooltip.omnitech.reactor_cell.desc: A reactor slot for a fuel rod or control rod.
tooltip.omnitech.reactor_port.desc: Connects coolant flow and power output to a nuclear reactor.
tooltip.omnitech.nuclear_bomb.desc: A devastating explosive, triggered by redstone.
tooltip.omnitech.floppy_drive.desc: Reads and writes Floppy Disks for the Logic Machine.
tooltip.omnitech.keyboard.desc: Text input peripheral for the Logic Machine's terminal.
tooltip.omnitech.expansion_slot.desc: Adds RAM or other cards to a Logic Machine.
tooltip.omnitech.gpio_port.desc: General-purpose I/O pins the Logic Machine can read and drive.
tooltip.omnitech.linux_rom.desc: A pre-flashed Firmware ROM that boots Linux.
tooltip.omnitech.firmware_rom.desc: Stores a program the Logic Machine boots from.
tooltip.omnitech.display.desc: Shows the Logic Machine's terminal or framebuffer output.
tooltip.omnitech.display_mk2.desc: A larger, higher-resolution version of the Display.
tooltip.omnitech.logic_gate_block.desc: A configurable logic gate for digital circuits.
tooltip.omnitech.redstone_intersection_b: Lets two signal lines cross without connecting.
tooltip.omnitech.orrery.desc: Displays the positions of the solar system's planets and moons.
